channel.description: Recent content in Research on Jinseong Park

item.title: Differential Privacy & Machine Learning
item.description: Developing privacy-preserving machine learning algorithms with rigorous differential privacy (DP) guarantees, including DP-SGD optimization, private SVMs, and synthetic data generation.

item.title: Generative AI & Diffusion Models
item.description: Studying the theory and applications of diffusion models, including time series generation, fairness-aware generation, machine unlearning, and financial modeling.

item.title: Adversarial Robustness
item.description: Understanding and improving the robustness of deep learning models against adversarial attacks, with focus on certifiable defenses, robust generalization measures, and audio security.

item.title: Time Series Analysis
item.description: Advancing time series forecasting and classification with modern deep learning, including self-attention analysis, sharpness-aware training, and data-driven anomaly detection.
